title: Double Drip Fizzy Cherry Cola Bottles E-Liquid 10ml
description: The flavour connoisseurs at Double Drip bring you our ultra-delicious candy-coated concoction in a handy 10ml bottle! Fizzy Cherry Cola Bottles is alive with tangy notes of ripe cherry and ever-so-slightly spiced cola, made even sweeter with a liberal dusting of sparkling sherbet sugar crystals. You’ll also notice subtle hints of cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg on the exhale, giving this vape a wonderfully-warming sensation as well as being vibrant, refreshing and super-sweet. So fill your paper bag with generous handfuls of Fizzy Cherry Cola Bottles before the sweetie jar is empty! Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
